dlentry.dd: The files built for one reader: documentation, manifest, report and hashes.
A DITA reference topic that states one requirement, its legal source and a key such as aia.xi-2d.
A documentation topic, such as a model card section, that answers a requirement.
The DITA reltable that links each requirement to its evidence.
A file that keeps or removes content by audience and product at build time.
A requirement with no evidence topic in the pack.
Authority-only content in a build for a reader who must not get it.
Your private overlay of links, decisions and tests, kept for . It never changes the source.
